# HW2

Row
-------------------------------------

### Plot 1: Three-Gear Cars are Dominant 
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
mtcars_gear=mtcars$gear|>table()|>as.data.frame()
plot_gear= ggplot(mtcars_gear, aes(x=factor(Var1), y=Freq, label=Freq)) +
  geom_bar(stat = 'identity', fill = "lightgrey") +
  geom_text(hjust=1,size=9, color='blue') + coord_flip() + labs(x='Gear', title = 'Count of Cars per GEAR', caption = "Source: mtcars data") + theme_classic() + theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.line.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"), axis.title = element_text(face = "bold")) 
plot_gear
```
Row
-------------------------------------

### Plot 2: Few Cars have SIX or more Carburators 
```{r}
mtcars_carb = mtcars$carb|>table()|>as.data.frame()
plot_carb= ggplot(mtcars_carb, aes(x=factor(Var1), y=Freq, label = Freq)) +
  geom_bar(stat = 'identity', fill = "yellow") +
  geom_text(hjust=0.5,vjust = -0.5, size=4, color='black') + labs(x='CARB', title = 'Count of Cars per CARB', caption = "Source: mtcars data") + theme_classic() + theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(), axis.line.y = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold"), plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")) 
plot_carb
```

Row
-------------------------------------

### Plot 3: Only 5-gear cars utilize the 6 and 8 carburetor setups. 
```{r}
plot3 = ggplot(data=mtcars,aes(x=factor(cyl))) + geom_bar(fill = "yellow") + facet_grid(gear~carb,labeller = label_both) + geom_text(stat = "count",
    aes(label = scales::percent(after_stat(count / sum(count)))),hjust=0.5,vjust = 2, size=2, color='black', fontface = "bold") + labs(x='cylinders', title = 'Distribution of Cylinder Counts by Carburetors and Gears', caption = "Source: mtcars data") + theme_light()
plot3
```

# HW3

Row
-------------------------------------

```{r setup-massdata, include=FALSE}
library(readxl)
mass_schools <- read_excel("ncesdata_MASS_202425.xlsx", skip = 10)
colnames(mass_schools) <- as.character(mass_schools[1, ])
mass_schools <- mass_schools[-1, ]
head(mass_schools)

str(mass_schools,width = 70,strict.width='cut')
unique(mass_schools$Locale)

absoluteLocale=table(mass_schools$Locale,
                 useNA = "ifany") 


tableFreq=as.data.frame(absoluteLocale)


propT=prop.table(absoluteLocale)*100


names(tableFreq)=c("Locale","Count")
tableFreq$Percent=as.vector(propT)

library(ggplot2)

tableFreq$Locale <- factor(tableFreq$Locale,
                    levels = c("City, Large", "City, Midsize", "City, Small", "Suburban, Large", "Suburban, Midsize", "Suburban, Small", "Town, Distant", "Town, Fringe", "Rural, Distant", "Rural, Fringe"))
```

Row
-------------------------------------

### Categorical Plot: Massachusetts School Locale
```{r, echo=FALSE}
base= ggplot(data = tableFreq, 
             aes(x = Locale, y = Percent)) 
titleText='Where are Public Schools located?'
sub_titleText='Massachusetts - 2024-2025'
sourceText='Source: National Center for Education Statistics'

paste0(round(tableFreq$Percent,2), '%')
LABELS=paste0(round(tableFreq$Percent,2), '%')

plot1 = base + geom_col(fill ="gray") + labs(title=titleText, subtitle = sub_titleText, x =NULL, y = NULL,caption = sourceText) + theme_bw() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) + geom_text(vjust=-0.25, size = 3.5, aes(y = Percent ,label = LABELS)) 
plot1


```


Row
-------------------------------------

### Numeric Plot: 
```{r}
mass_schools$`Student Teacher Ratio` <- as.numeric(mass_schools$`Student Teacher Ratio`)
#summary(mass_schools$`Student Teacher Ratio`)

library(moments)

md=median(mass_schools$`Student Teacher Ratio` ,na.rm = TRUE)
mn=mean(mass_schools$`Student Teacher Ratio` ,na.rm = TRUE)
sk=skewness(mass_schools$`Student Teacher Ratio` ,na.rm = TRUE)

txtMean=paste0('Mean:',round(mn))
txtSkew=paste0('Skewness:',round(sk,2))
txtMedian=paste0('Median:',round(md,2))

base=ggplot(mass_schools, aes(x=0, y=`Student Teacher Ratio`))+theme_classic()
boxRatio=base + geom_boxplot() 

box_data <- ggplot_build(boxRatio)$data[[1]]

lower_whisker <- box_data$lower[1]  # numeric value of lower whisker
upper_whisker <- box_data$upper[1]  # numeric value of upper whisker

outliers <- box_data$outliers[[1]]

lowOcount <- sum(outliers < lower_whisker)
upperOcount <- sum(outliers > upper_whisker)

txtOutliersUp <- paste0("upper outlying schools: ", upperOcount)
txtOutliersLo <- paste0("lower outlying schools: ", lowOcount)

y_upper_label <- upper_whisker * 2.75
y_lower_label <- lower_whisker * 0.3

vio=base+geom_violin(trim=FALSE, fill="grey")

viobox=vio+ 
        scale_y_continuous(trans = scales::pseudo_log_trans(base = 10)) + 
        geom_boxplot(width=0.25,
                        outlier.color = 'red',
                        colour = 'white',
                        fill='black') + coord_flip()

viobox=viobox + theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
                      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
                      axis.title.y = element_blank()) + 
               # about the outliers       
                      annotate(geom = 'text',size=3,
                               label=txtOutliersUp,
                                y = y_upper_label,
                                x=0.1,color='red',
                                angle=0) +
                      annotate(geom = 'text', size=3, 
                               label=txtOutliersLo,
                                y = y_lower_label,
                                x=0.1,color='red',
                                angle=0) +
              # about the mean
              geom_hline(yintercept = mn,color='darkgreen',
                         linetype="dotted") +
              # about the mean
              annotate(geom = 'text',color='darkgreen',
                       fontface = "bold",
                       label=txtMean, # mean as text
                       x = 0.22,
                       y=mn+1,
                       angle=90)   +
                      annotate(geom = 'text',color='white', 
                               size=3, fontface = "bold",
                               label=txtMedian, # median as text
                                x = 0,
                                y=md-.75,
                                angle=90)
viobox 
```
